source_review: Exact-hash existing ISO helper imports with owned ROOT and primary read-only WHEEL override only; six fixed payload destinations and explicit baseline/candidate/fixture roles.

Baseline -buildvcs=false, Linux/amd64 CGO0 readonly offline build, complete selected linked input catalog and frozen tools. Root248-file source manifest is historical binary build scope; current linked source catalog is distinct.

Pinned signature-verified Alma9.8 backing image used through disposable overlay, external NIC disabled, no host shares. Cloud-init stages payload but suppresses requested default cloud user and SSH key creation; installed policy snapshot begins after staging.

Guest uses existing unique UID65534 from passwd metadata, no identity creation, account utility execution, NSS/default rewriting, shadow/key or credential read. Policy metadata/hashes and listeners measured before and after both owned broker children.

Guest actual diagnostic must exit1 with fixed seven-field refused report; old broker must create only three empty declared directories, candidate none, no store/socket. Binary/fixture hash before and after.

20s broker/8192-16384 output bounds, owned child session/group cleanup and wait; host600s QEMU/2MiB bounds, owned direct process exit required. No guest-host hostile isolation or full provisioning claim.

Nonce exact-three-marker frame, canonical nested JSON, strict known fields/IDs/order/modes/hashes/bounds, policy/listener equality and cleanup booleans. Raw boot remains private and opaque; CRLF normalized only, framed CR/ANSI refused.
